title: 第1章 大修炼时代

content_zh:
静海市十三中，高三十一班的教室内，一个约莫着三十岁上下，身穿干练黑色短打武道服的男子在说话。
教室的中央是一片巨大的席子，他就站在席子的中央。
而在他的周围，则是围坐着五十多个学生，都是十一班内的学生，这些学生大多数都是十六七岁的模样，有男有女，同样一身武道服。
而在这些学生当中，一个偏僻的角落之中，一个约莫着十五六岁的少年，看着身材健硕，模样清秀，在这些学生之中，实在是太过平庸和不起眼了。
楚云凡看着中央的那个男子，那是他们高三十一班的武道教头，秦武，听说是从军中特种部队退下来的，在军中也立下过许多的功劳，但是后来不知道为什么就突然退役了，来到了十三中教书，他们修行上的问题，基本上都是他在教。
“所以古人有所谓穷文富武的说法，这其实是一种很直观的认识，为什么只有富人才可以练武？”秦武说着，停顿了一下，指着一个学生，开口说道。“你说，为什么！”
那个学生楞了一下，然后开口说道：“因为习武的过程就是不断消耗自身精血的过程，如果只有消耗，而没有补充的话，这个人死的会很快，古时候人参灵芝之类的补药都很贵，一般人根本消费不起！”
“对，所以公历时代即便有修炼的人，也很少，根本就是凤毛麟角，一直到昆仑历，我们人类发现了昆仑界，发现了超古代文明，科技和武道双重大爆发，像人参灵芝，几十年的，上百年的都随随便便的可以量产了，都端上了普通人的餐桌，所以才能够支撑得起我们人人都习武的超级修炼时代！”秦武点点头说道。
此时楚云凡脑海之中却是浮现出了在历史课上学到的关于昆仑历的历史。
数百年前，公历时代2035年，一道巨大的剑芒撕裂天际，贯穿宇宙，落入了大西洋之中。
整个地球陷入一片巨大的灾难之中，无数国家覆灭，哀鸿遍野，世界人口不足十亿，而其中绝大部分都是华夏人，因而开启了华夏复兴时代。
因为这一场灾难，地球大半崩坏，人类开始了找寻另外一个生存家园的道路。
最终，人们在被剑芒撕裂的裂缝的另外一边，发现了一个广阔无垠的世界，就是现在的昆仑界。
人类也进入了昆仑历的时代！
人类踏入昆仑界才发现，这个昆仑界不仅仅适合人类生存，同时也适合一些强大的生物生存，因为灵气的存在，让这个大陆上生存着许许多多强大无比的妖兽。
就算是掌握了高科技的人类，也无法敌得过这些数量无穷的强大妖兽，一些强大的妖兽，甚至连核弹都轰不死，在这种情况下，别说移民昆仑界，甚至一度被打到两界边缘，被入侵到人类的大本营，地球。
就在这个时候，人类移民发现了在这个昆仑界上存在的超古代文明，和地球人类走的完全是另外一个体系，凭借修炼以强大自身，抗衡妖兽的武道体系。
这一切简直就像是许多年前玄幻小说里所说的异世界，凭借着挖掘出来的越来越多的超古代文明的资料，包括功法等诸多体系的整理，地球移民开始了全民习武的大时代。
以武者和高科技双重力量，人类才开始在昆仑界上立足，不至于被那些妖兽灭族。
即便如此，人类依旧时时刻刻面对这些强大妖兽的威胁，所建立的城市依旧可能被攻破，一旦被攻破，就是数十万，上百万，乃至上千万人惨遭屠杀，这样的事情只在这数百年间便发生了许多次。

地球静海市十三中，只是静海市数十所中学之中一家非常普通的高中而已。
在大灾变之后，地球上大部分的环境已经不适合人类生存了，所以整体的居住格局已经一改公历时代极为分散的局面，一共形成了十大基地市，每一座基地市中都有上亿的人口，加起来，也足足有十几亿的人口还在地球，并没有前往昆仑界之中。

content_en:
In the classroom of Class 31, No. 13 Middle School in Jinghai City, a man about thirty years old, wearing a smart black short-fight martial arts uniform, was talking.
In the center of the classroom was a huge mat, and he was standing in the center of it.
Around him, there were more than fifty students sitting around, all students from Class 11. Most of these students were sixteen or seventeen years old, both male and female, and they were also wearing martial arts uniforms.
And among these students, in a remote corner, there was a young man about fifteen or sixteen years old. He looked strong and handsome. Among these students, he was really mediocre and inconspicuous.
Chu Yunfan looked at the man in the center. He was the martial arts instructor of Class 31, Qin Wu. He was said to have retired from the special forces in the army. He also made many contributions in the army, but then he suddenly retired for unknown reasons and came to teach at No. 13 Middle School. He was basically the one who taught them all about their cultivation problems.
"So the ancients had the saying that the poor in culture and the rich in martial arts are actually a very intuitive understanding. Why can only rich people practice martial arts?" Qin Wu said, paused, pointed to a student, and said. "Tell me why!"
The student was stunned for a moment, and then said: "Because the process of practicing martial arts is a process of constantly consuming one's own essence and blood. If there is only consumption without replenishment, this person will die very quickly. In ancient times, tonics such as ginseng and Ganoderma lucidum were very expensive, and most people couldn't afford them!"
"Yes, so even if there were practitioners in the Gregorian calendar era, there were very few people. They were simply rare. Until the Kunlun Calendar, we humans discovered the Kunlun world and discovered the super-ancient civilization. There was a double explosion of technology and martial arts. For example, ginseng and Ganoderma lucidum can be mass-produced for decades or hundreds of years and are served on the dining tables of ordinary people. That's why we can support the era of super cultivation where everyone practices martial arts!" Qin Wu nodded and said.
At this time, the history of the Kunlun Calendar that he learned in history class appeared in Chu Yunfan's mind.
Hundreds of years ago, in the year 2035 of the Gregorian calendar, a huge sword light tore through the sky, penetrated the universe, and fell into the Atlantic Ocean.
The entire earth fell into a huge disaster. Countless countries were destroyed and victims were everywhere. The world's population was less than one billion, and most of them were Chinese, thus starting the era of Chinese rejuvenation.
Because of this disaster, most of the earth collapsed, and humans began to find another home for survival.
In the end, people discovered a vast world on the other side of the crack torn apart by the sword, which is now the Kunlun world.
Humanity has also entered the era of the Kunlun Calendar!
Only when humans entered the Kunlun Realm did they realize that this Kunlun Realm was not only suitable for human survival, but also suitable for the survival of some powerful creatures. Because of the existence of spiritual energy, many extremely powerful monsters existed on this continent.
Even humans who have mastered high technology cannot defeat these endless numbers of powerful monsters. Some powerful monsters cannot even be killed by nuclear bombs. In this case, let alone immigrating to the Kunlun Realm, they were even pushed to the edge of the two realms and invaded the human base camp, the Earth.
At this time, human immigrants discovered the super-ancient civilization that existed in the Kunlun world. It followed a completely different system from humans on Earth. It relied on cultivation to strengthen itself and compete with the martial arts system of monsters.
All of this is simply like the different world mentioned in fantasy novels many years ago. With the help of more and more unearthed information about super-ancient civilizations, including the arrangement of many systems such as martial arts, the immigrants of the earth have begun a great era of martial arts practice for all people.
With the dual power of warriors and high technology, human beings began to gain a foothold in the Kunlun Realm without being wiped out by those monsters.
Even so, human beings are still facing these powerfulDue to the threat of monsters, the city built may still be breached. Once it is breached, hundreds of thousands, millions, or even tens of millions of people will be massacred. This kind of thing has happened many times in the past few hundred years.
No. 13 Middle School in Jinghai City on Earth is just a very ordinary high school among dozens of middle schools in Jinghai City.
After the cataclysm, most of the environment on the earth is no longer suitable for human survival. Therefore, the overall residential pattern has changed from the extremely scattered situation in the Gregorian calendar era. A total of ten base cities have been formed. Each base city has a population of hundreds of millions. Taken together, there are more than a billion people still on the earth and have not gone to the Kunlun Realm.
